constraint: design_os.app_user app_user_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id)
constraint: design_os.app_user app_user_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint: design_os.app_user app_user_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['ACTIVE'::text, 'DISABLED'::text])))
constraint: design_os.appliance appliance_code_unique UNIQUE (org_id, code)
constraint: design_os.appliance appliance_org_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (org_id) REFERENCES design_os.organization(id)
constraint: design_os.appliance appliance_org_id_unique UNIQUE (org_id, id)
constraint: design_os.appliance appliance_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog appliance_catalog_code_unique UNIQUE (org_id, code)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog appliance_catalog_org_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (org_id) REFERENCES design_os.organization(id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog appliance_catalog_org_id_unique UNIQUE (org_id, id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog appliance_catalog_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_approved_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (approved_by) REFERENCES design_os.app_user(id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_approved_iff CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['APPROVED'::design_os.record_lifecycle_status, 'LOCKED'::design_os.record_lifecycle_status, 'SUPERSEDED'::design_os.record_lifecycle_status])) = ((approved_by IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (effective_from IS NOT NULL))))
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_approver_not_submitter CHECK (((approved_by IS NULL) OR (approved_by <> submitted_by)))
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_content_hash_format CHECK ((content_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES design_os.app_user(id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_entity_fk FOREIGN KEY (org_id, entity_id) REFERENCES design_os.appliance_catalog(org_id, id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_locked_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (locked_by) REFERENCES design_os.app_user(id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_locked_iff CHECK ((((locked_by IS NULL) = (locked_at IS NULL)) AND ((status <> 'LOCKED'::design_os.record_lifecycle_status) OR (locked_by IS NOT NULL)) AND ((status <> ALL (ARRAY['DRAFT'::design_os.record_lifecycle_status, 'IN_REVIEW'::design_os.record_lifecycle_status, 'APPROVED'::design_os.record_lifecycle_status])) OR (locked_by IS NULL))))
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_not_self_superseded CHECK (((superseded_by IS NULL) OR (superseded_by <> id)))
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_org_entity_id_unique UNIQUE (org_id, entity_id, id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_org_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (org_id) REFERENCES design_os.organization(id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_org_id_unique UNIQUE (org_id, id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_production_only CHECK ((data_classification = 'PRODUCTION'::text))
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_reason_required CHECK ((btrim(change_reason) <> ''::text))
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_source_required CHECK ((btrim(source) <> ''::text))
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_submitted_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (submitted_by) REFERENCES design_os.app_user(id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_submitted_iff CHECK ((((status = 'DRAFT'::design_os.record_lifecycle_status) = ((submitted_by IS NULL) AND (submitted_at IS NULL))) AND ((submitted_by IS NULL) = (submitted_at IS NULL))))
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_superseded_by_fk FOREIGN KEY (org_id, entity_id, superseded_by) REFERENCES design_os.appliance_catalog_version(org_id, entity_id, id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_superseded_iff CHECK (((status = 'SUPERSEDED'::design_os.record_lifecycle_status) = ((superseded_by IS NOT NULL) AND (superseded_at IS NOT NULL))))
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_version_number_check CHECK ((version_number >= 1))
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version appliance_catalog_version_version_number_unique UNIQUE (org_id, entity_id, version_number)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version_appliance appliance_catalog_version_appliance_catalog_fk FOREIGN KEY (org_id, catalog_version_id) REFERENCES design_os.appliance_catalog_version(org_id, id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version_appliance appliance_catalog_version_appliance_item_fk FOREIGN KEY (org_id, appliance_id, appliance_version_id) REFERENCES design_os.appliance_version(org_id, entity_id, id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_catalog_version_appliance appliance_catalog_version_appliance_pkey PRIMARY KEY (catalog_version_id, appliance_id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_version appliance_version_approved_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (approved_by) REFERENCES design_os.app_user(id)
constraint: design_os.appliance_version appliance_version_approved_iff CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['APPROVED'::design_os.record_lifecycle_status, 'LOCKED'::design_os.record_lifecycle_status, 'SUPERSEDED'::design_os.record_lifecycle_status])) = ((approved_by IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (effective_from IS NOT NULL))))
constraint: design_os.appliance_version appliance_version_approver_not_submitter CHECK (((approved_by IS NULL) OR (approved_by <> submitted_by)))
constraint: design_os.appliance_version appliance_version_content_hash_format CHECK ((content_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
constraint: design_os.appliance_version appliance_version_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES design_os.app_user(id)
